Total foodgrain.rationale: District-wide sum of all cereals and pulses; causes double-counting and has no single biological crop identity.

Pulses total.rationale: District-wide sum of all pulse crops; double-counts individual pulses.

Oilseeds total.rationale: District-wide sum of 9 major oilseeds; double-counts individual oilseeds.

Other Kharif pulses.rationale: Heterogeneous multi-species mixture of minor kharif legumes (cowpea, kulthi, moth, lablab) without fixed botanical proportions.

Other Rabi pulses.rationale: Heterogeneous multi-species mixture of minor rabi pulses (khesari, field pea, lathyrus residuals).

Peas & beans (Pulses).rationale: Combines dry field peas (Pisum sativum) with diverse grain beans (Phaseolus, Vicia spp.) with differing growth habits.

Other Cereals & Millets.rationale: Residual bin for minor millets and pseudo-cereals without individual yield characteristics.

other oilseeds.rationale: Residual bin for minor or wild oilseeds with undefined species composition.

Other Fresh Fruits.rationale: Heterogeneous mixture of perennial tree fruits (custard apple, ber, fig, passion fruit, jamun) with wildly differing tree spacings and bearing cycles.

Other Vegetables.rationale: Heterogeneous mixture of leafy greens, gourds, and tubers with moisture content ranging 80-95%.

Pome Fruit.rationale: Combines apple, pear, and quince across temperate hill tracts; distinct chilling and yield curves.

Citrus Fruit.rationale: Combines mandarin, sweet orange, lime, and pomelo across diverse rootstocks and densities.

Beans & Mutter(Vegetable).rationale: Fresh green vegetable pods (~80-85% moisture) harvested for horticulture, not comparable to dry pulse grain.

Kapas.rationale: Raw unginned seed cotton (contains ~65% heavy seed and ~35% lint). Standard commercial cotton reporting is ginned lint in bales of 170 kg. Non-comparable product basis.

Cashewnut Processed.rationale: Edible deshelled cashew kernels. Standard reporting in India is raw unshelled nut in shell (Cashewnut / Cashewnut Raw), which has only 22-28% kernel recovery. 4x conversion disparity.
